purpose: Independently review the INIT-003 full engineering-organization readiness validation.
scope: Review the exact organizational changes and evidence since source commit 1ccaace.
Review registration, owner-instruction provenance, required fields, pairwise boundaries, interfaces, and readiness for AU-CODEX-PRIMARY and AU-AGENT-001 through AU-AGENT-006.
Review documentation consistency, Source of Truth, traceability, status semantics, and Documentation Impact.
Review Collaboration Bridge contracts, self-test evidence, completed-exchange integrity, shared-folder safety, and synchronization conclusions.
Review TASK-THINSLICE-001 executor mapping, open gates, and the prohibition on development before Technical Review.
Assess every OVR finding and return an evidence-based independent acceptance decision.
out_of_scope: Changing product requirements, product behavior, approved terminology, scope, priorities, UX, or acceptance criteria.
Changing engineering architecture, role meaning, implementation, runtime, technology, platform, data model, API, or synchronization design.
Implementing product features, fixing Bridge tooling, or silently repairing organizational findings.
Reviewing the substantive binary Master Product Specification.
Using Git, committing, pushing, merging, or directly editing the canonical repository.
Assigning product or project VERIFIED without reviewing the exact registered source and evidence.
expected_outputs: return-manifest.json conforming to the registered return schema.
outputs/acceptance-report.md containing reviewed source identity, evidence assessment, finding dispositions, limitations, risks, and the independent acceptance rationale.
acceptance_criteria: The exact range 1ccaace4aa6c5a441dca52bcbbab3fd26017f908..f748c9551175d24b22106b826354c8fc5878e0c6 and registered source checksums are reviewed.
All seven engineering roles and their owner-instruction evidence are assessed without assuming registration correctness.
Every required role field, all 21 pairwise boundaries, independent review ownership, and self-acceptance prohibitions are assessed.
Documentation, Source of Truth, traceability, status, Documentation Impact, and persistent-state claims are assessed.
Bridge schemas, scripts, tests, archive integrity, shared-folder safety, synchronization, and communication-contract claims are assessed from registered evidence.
TASK-THINSLICE-001 intake mapping and every development blocker are assessed without approving implementation.
OVR-001 through OVR-005 and existing INIT-002-F2/F5 limitations are explicitly accepted, rejected, or returned for rework with evidence.
No product or technical meaning is invented or changed by the reviewer.
The return decision is exactly VERIFIED or REWORK_REQUIRED and is limited to the registered INIT-003 scope.

authority_boundaries.product_authority: Claude Cowork may independently review product and organizational acceptance within the registered scope but may not change product meaning through this review.
authority_boundaries.engineering_authority: AU-CODEX-PRIMARY governs the engineering organization; AU-AGENT-001 and assigned domain agents retain technical meaning and implementation authority; AU-AGENT-003 retains task-scoped independent engineering verification without product-acceptance authority. Claude must not directly edit engineering artifacts.
authority_boundaries.documentation_authority: AU-AGENT-002 owns documentation structure, navigation, terminology records, traceability, and lifecycle without changing product, technical, role, or review meaning.
authority_boundaries.git_authority: AU-CODEX-PRIMARY is the sole Git writer and GitHub operator; Claude must not run Git or mutate the canonical repository.
